### Native worksheet annotation controls — estate-61749b0088e2 / delivery_path

A distinct follow-through on the integrated #21/#22 worksheet: let a reviewer list saved findings and enter an explicit status, reviewer and note without editing protected CSV columns by hand.

Qualified source is main `9e931fa9f42033bf2368f7149684fb5631345715`, tree `0b0c903801f432968e9cdfb1f1fa134cecc37217`; the complete tree has no AGENTS.md. Existing review validator/publisher blob `2475217ce9c073c39756f9fa3926342cd83f7254` and CLI blob `8655fdb7cd1e4735ece1da1727b68af6401e40a8` were materialized exactly with the 19-file Utility package. Actual native generate → run → review succeeds; the resulting saved worksheet is preserved when `worksheet list` refuses as an unknown command (exit 2, empty stdout).

**Bounded source:** new `utility_watch/uwatch/worksheet.py`; four additive CLI registration/dispatch lines; new `utility_watch/tests/test_worksheet_cli.py` and `utility_watch/docs/worksheet-cli.md`; a narrow README link and compact unique receiving evidence. `worksheet list` validates the complete saved file and exposes exact row IDs, filters and recorded report context. `worksheet annotate` requires an exact current row ID, all three explicit annotation fields and a new output path. It uses the unchanged native manifest/validator and no-overwrite publisher; protected cells, other rows, history and original files remain unchanged. Unicode/multiline note text is retained exactly. Existing `review --previous` continues to reconcile evidence; annotations do not clear flags or authorize payment.

Fresh project issues and central #140/#142/#143 reads found no annotation-command owner. The separate printable consumer remains with `estate-accel-e04ee971c817` (`review_report.py` / `review-report`, #142 comment6060070875); #25's account/bill checker identity, #24's CSV headers, original reconciliation, report, generator, PT/Freight, demos and CI stay preserved. Any same-file CLI/README integration will compose only the additive seams.

Isolated work is under `/dev/shm/hamon-61749b-utility-worksheet`, using installed Python and authored synthetic data. Qualification includes real CLI annotation → existing native reconciliation, exact-cell/input preservation, same-ID cross-account selection, historical/invalid selection refusal and failed/raced publication controls. No browser, provider, real financial data, installed source or service operation. Root coordinates independent receiving and normal source publication.
chronology: Local source implementation began under root's standing direction while the serialized coordination write was queued; publication is not represented as preceding edits.
